pr_title: GameEngine: define post-first-release AI roadmap ADRs
pr_body:
## Summary

- add ADR 0140 as the dependency and parallel-delivery map for post-first-release AI work
- split native Agent, benchmark/catalog, backend resource controls, hosted providers, external agent adapters, asset acquisition, detached frontend, remote lifecycle, live media, multi-model routing, headless writer, multi-agent writing, and sandbox integration into ADR 0141-0153
- record which ADRs can start in parallel and which require measured or ownership prerequisites
- keep ADR 0121/0131/0133/0135 first-release contracts authoritative

## Scope

Documentation and architecture only. No Editor/runtime implementation changes. Windows Validation should select docs mode; Visual Validation is not required.
